agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario is single ball dropping to floor (y=0) with e≈0.907, no controller. At step 60 it approaches floor with speed 18.67 and energy ~3017 (near E0). Bounce at step 60->61 reverses vy to +19.73, energy jumps to 3363 exceeding allowed 3324. The restitution impulse is not energy-conserving in combination with gravity substepping/position correction, adding ~346 J in one bounce. Setting e=0 makes it inelastic so no energy gain.
